timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹44.1 Cr, net profit ₹4.75 Cr (against a loss of ₹25.09 Cr a year earlier).
Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation announced that its board meeting to consider a dividend has been adjourned to 4th June, 2026.

The Punjab Produce & Trading Co. Pvt. Ltd. (acting for promoters and persons acting in concert) declared no encumbrance on its 17.52% stake in Pilani Investment & Industries Corporation Ltd. under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4), April 2, 2026.
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of ₹9 per equity share (90% of ₹10 face value) for FY2026, pending shareholder approval at AGM.
Birla Group Holdings Private Limited, as promoter, declared no new encumbrances on Pilani Investment and Industries Corporation Limited shares by 31-Mar-2026.
